title: Science Teacher (Chemistry or Physics)
summary: A forward-thinking, inclusive secondary school is appointing a Science teacher with a Chemistry or Physics specialism.
body:
## The position

A forward-thinking and inclusive secondary school in Southend-on-Sea is seeking a passionate, dedicated Science teacher with a specialism in Chemistry or Physics to join its successful department.

It's an exciting opportunity for an ambitious teacher to inspire students and contribute to a high-performing Science team committed to engaging, impactful lessons.

## The role

- Teach Science across Key Stages 3 and 4.
- Opportunity to teach Key Stage 5 (depending on experience and specialism).
- Plan and deliver high-quality, engaging lessons.
- Support students of all abilities to achieve their full potential.
- Contribute to curriculum development and departmental improvement.

## What you'll need

- Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) or equivalent.
- A specialism in Chemistry or Physics.
- Strong subject knowledge and a passion for Science education.
- The ability to motivate and inspire learners.
- A commitment to raising attainment and delivering excellent outcomes.
- A positive, collaborative approach to teamwork.

## What the school offers

- A supportive, well-resourced Science department.
- Professional development and career progression.
- A collaborative and inclusive working environment.
- Strong leadership and a clear vision for improvement.
- Staff wellbeing initiatives and benefits.

It's a fantastic opportunity to join a school that values staff and students alike, where you can develop your career and make a real impact in the classroom.
